meaning.en: Suddenly and unexpectedly; at a moment when no one is prepared.
meaning.zh: 趁人不防备的时候，突然。

examples.zh: 他正在看电视，弟弟抽冷子在背后吓了他一跳。
examples.en: He was watching TV when his brother suddenly gave him a fright from behind.

examples.zh: 别抽冷子问我，我没准备。
examples.en: Don't spring a question on me out of the blue; I'm not prepared.

usage.en: Adverbial; northern colloquial. 冷子 means a sudden, unguarded moment.
usage.zh: 作状语，北方口语。“冷子”指没有防备的时刻。

meaning.en: To slip away quickly, usually to avoid trouble or responsibility.
meaning.zh: 像脚底涂了油一样溜得飞快，多指偷偷逃走。

examples.zh: 一听说要加班，他就脚底抹油溜了。
examples.en: The moment he heard about overtime, he made himself scarce.

examples.zh: 看见老板过来，几个人赶紧脚底抹油。
examples.en: Seeing the boss approach, a few of them quickly slipped away.

usage.en: Humorous; the image is of slippery oiled soles that make you slide off fast.
usage.zh: 带戏谑意味；想象脚底抹了油，一溜就跑。

meaning.en: To get rid of a burden or troublesome responsibility by pushing it onto others.
meaning.zh: 把负担或麻烦的事推给别人，自己摆脱。

examples.zh: 公司想甩包袱，把亏损的部门卖掉了。
examples.en: The company, wanting to offload its burdens, sold off the loss-making unit.

examples.zh: 他把烂摊子一甩，这是甩包袱的做法。
examples.en: Dumping the mess like that is just shedding a burden onto others.

usage.en: Usually critical. 包袱 is a cloth bundle, hence a load one carries; compare 背包袱.
usage.zh: 多含贬义。“包袱”本指布包，引申为负担；参见“背包袱”。

meaning.en: To paper over a dispute with vague compromise instead of settling who is right.
meaning.zh: 不讲原则，只一味调和，把矛盾含糊地掩盖过去。

examples.zh: 领导不能总是抹稀泥，得拿出明确的意见。
examples.en: A leader can't keep smoothing things over; they must give a clear view.

examples.zh: 两人吵起来，他在中间抹稀泥，谁也没说服。
examples.en: When the two argued, he papered over it and convinced neither.

usage.en: Critical. Image: plastering a wall with watery mud to hide cracks. 和稀泥 is the more common form.
usage.zh: 带贬义。像用稀泥抹平墙缝。“和稀泥”更常说。

meaning.en: An extremely low price, as if the seller were desperate.
meaning.zh: 价格低到极点的甩卖价，像卖家走投无路。

examples.zh: 这批库存只卖跳楼价，快来抢！
examples.en: This stock is going at fire-sale prices, come and grab it!

examples.zh: 跳楼价虽然诱人，也要看看质量。
examples.en: A rock-bottom price is tempting, but check the quality too.

usage.en: Noun, common in shop advertising. Often with 甩卖.
usage.zh: 名词，常见于商家宣传，常与“甩卖”连用。

meaning.en: To make an occasion look impressive, or to keep up a show of status.
meaning.zh: 把场面撑起来，保持体面或排场。

examples.zh: 婚礼上他请了很多亲友撑场面。
examples.en: He invited many relatives and friends to give the wedding some weight.

examples.zh: 为了撑场面，他租了辆名车。
examples.en: To keep up appearances he rented a fancy car.

usage.en: Compare 撑场子, which is about lending support to an event by showing up.
usage.zh: 与“撑场子”不同，后者侧重到场捧场。

natural: be weighed down by a burden

meaning.en: To be weighed down mentally by a worry, a past mistake or a heavy responsibility.
meaning.zh: 心里背着沉重的负担，如思想包袱、历史包袱。

examples.zh: 考砸了别背包袱，下次再努力。
examples.en: Don't carry the burden of a failed exam; try harder next time.

examples.zh: 他背着家庭的包袱，一直不敢辞职。
examples.en: Weighed down by family obligations, he never dared to quit.

usage.en: Often 背思想包袱 (be mentally burdened). Opposite of 甩包袱/放下包袱.
usage.zh: 常说“背思想包袱”。反义“放下包袱”。

meaning.en: To repeat old material or ideas with nothing new added.
meaning.zh: 把旧东西重复拿出来，没有新意。

examples.zh: 这部续集只是炒冷饭，毫无新意。
examples.en: This sequel just rehashes old stuff with nothing new.

examples.zh: 别再炒冷饭了，说点新的吧。
examples.en: Stop reheating old rice; say something new.

usage.en: Often applied to films, songs and speeches.
usage.zh: 常用于电影、歌曲、讲话等。

meaning.en: To expose someone's embarrassing past or secrets.
meaning.zh: 把别人过去不光彩的事情或隐私揭露出来。

examples.zh: 吵架的时候她专门揭他的老底。
examples.en: In the quarrel she kept digging up his past.

examples.zh: 他怕同学揭老底，不敢说小时候的事。
examples.en: Afraid classmates would expose his past, he didn't dare talk about childhood.

usage.en: Usually 揭……的老底. Similar to 揭短 but about past history.
usage.zh: 常说“揭……的老底”，与“揭短”近，偏重过去的事。

meaning.en: To cost someone their job or means of living.
meaning.zh: 使人失去工作或生计。

examples.zh: 你这样乱来，会砸了大家的饭碗。
examples.en: If you mess around like this, you'll cost everyone their jobs.

examples.zh: 他怕砸饭碗，什么都不敢说。
examples.en: Afraid of losing his job, he dares to say nothing.

usage.en: Also used of one's own job: 砸了自己的饭碗. 饭碗 = livelihood.
usage.zh: 也可指自己丢掉工作。“饭碗”指生计。

meaning.en: To grasp at any last hope, however slim, when in trouble.
meaning.zh: 处境危急时，抓住任何一点希望，哪怕很渺茫。

examples.zh: 公司快倒闭了，他到处捞稻草想找投资。
examples.en: With the firm near collapse, he clutched at straws to find investors.

examples.zh: 他到处捞稻草，可惜还是没救回来。
examples.en: He grabbed every last straw, yet couldn't save it.

usage.en: From the image of a drowning man seizing straw; more often said as 抓救命稻草.
usage.zh: 来自溺水者抓稻草的比喻，更常说“抓救命稻草”。

meaning.en: To extort wealth from the people through heavy exactions.
meaning.zh: 用各种手段搜刮民财。

examples.zh: 贪官刮地皮，百姓苦不堪言。
examples.en: The corrupt officials fleeced the people, who suffered terribly.

examples.zh: 那个老板把员工的钱都刮地皮似的收走了。
examples.en: That boss scraped up the staff's money like a looter.

usage.en: Originally about corrupt officials; also humorously about relentless profiteers.
usage.zh: 原指贪官搜刮，也可戏指无情牟利的人。

meaning.en: To make a decision casually, without investigation or data.
meaning.zh: 凭一时想法随意决策，不做调查研究。

examples.zh: 项目不能拍脑袋决定，要先做调研。
examples.en: A project can't be decided off the cuff; do research first.

examples.zh: 领导一拍脑袋，我们就得加班三个月。
examples.en: One whim from the boss and we're working overtime for three months.

usage.en: Often with 拍脑袋决策/拍脑袋工程. Variant: 拍脑门.
usage.zh: 常说“拍脑袋决策”“拍脑袋工程”。

meaning.en: To flatter and fawn over someone, especially one in power.
meaning.zh: 奉承、巴结有权势的人。

examples.zh: 他只会给上司捧臭脚，没什么真本事。
examples.en: All he can do is suck up to his superiors; he has no real skill.

examples.zh: 别人都在捧老板的臭脚，只有她敢说真话。
examples.en: Everyone else was fawning over the boss; only she dared tell the truth.

usage.en: Derogatory and crude, usually 捧……的臭脚. Said to come from opera fans lauding actors.
usage.zh: 含贬义，较粗俗，常说“捧……的臭脚”。

meaning.en: To grab the attention and praise that others deserve.
meaning.zh: 把别人应得的关注和荣誉抢到自己身上。

examples.zh: 新人太爱抢风头，同事们都不高兴。
examples.en: The newcomer likes stealing the limelight and colleagues are unhappy.

examples.zh: 今天是她的婚礼，伴娘可别抢她的风头。
examples.en: It's her wedding today, so the bridesmaid mustn't steal her thunder.

usage.en: Usually 抢……的风头. 风头 = prominence, from the image of the leading edge of the wind.
usage.zh: 常说“抢……的风头”。

meaning.en: To be too embarrassed to say no or to act, for fear of losing face.
meaning.zh: 碍于情面，不好意思拒绝或出面。

examples.zh: 朋友开口借钱，他抹不开面子，只好答应。
examples.en: When a friend asked for a loan, he was too embarrassed to refuse.

examples.zh: 我这人抹不开面子，不会拒绝别人。
examples.en: I'm the sort who can't say no for fear of awkwardness.

usage.en: Also 抹不开 alone. Common in northern speech, typically with 拉不下脸.
usage.zh: 也可只说“抹不开”，北方口语常见。

meaning.en: To make a friendly offer, such as peace or cooperation.
meaning.zh: 主动表示友好，提出和解或合作。

examples.zh: 公司向对手递出橄榄枝，希望合作。
examples.en: The firm extended an olive branch to its rival, hoping to cooperate.

examples.zh: 多家企业向这位球星递橄榄枝。
examples.en: Several companies have courted the star player.

usage.en: Borrowed from the Western olive branch of peace, now very common in news. Also 抛橄榄枝.
usage.zh: 源自西方以橄榄枝象征和平，新闻中很常见。也说“抛橄榄枝”。

meaning.en: To work one's contacts, often with gifts, to get something done.
meaning.zh: 四处走门路、托人情，求办某事。

examples.zh: 他为了职位到处跑关系。
examples.en: He's been working every connection for the post.

examples.zh: 做生意不能光靠跑关系，还得靠实力。
examples.en: In business you can't rely only on connections; you need real ability.

usage.en: Mildly negative; often with 托人情, 走后门.
usage.zh: 略带贬义，常与“托人情”“走后门”同用。

meaning.en: To stake claim to as much territory or market share as fast as possible.
meaning.zh: 迅速占领尽可能多的地盘或市场。

examples.zh: 共享单车公司当年疯狂跑马圈地。
examples.en: The bike-share companies were grabbing market share like mad.

examples.zh: 企业不能只顾跑马圈地，忽视了盈利。
examples.en: Firms can't just race to claim turf and ignore profit.

usage.en: From the old practice of riding a horse around a plot to claim it. Now a business term.
usage.zh: 源于旧时骑马圈占土地，现多用于商业。

meaning.en: To fall into a terrible situation, willingly or by being tricked.
meaning.zh: 陷入极端痛苦的境地，自愿或被骗。

examples.zh: 她被骗去那家公司，等于跳火坑。
examples.en: Being tricked into that company was like jumping into the fire.

examples.zh: 你嫁给他，那不是跳火坑吗？
examples.en: Marrying him would be jumping into a fire pit, wouldn't it?

usage.en: Often 往火坑里跳 / 推人入火坑 (push someone in).
usage.zh: 常说“往火坑里跳”“推入火坑”。

meaning.en: A folk shaman's trance dance to cure illness or drive out spirits, often used mockingly of superstition.
meaning.zh: 民间巫婆神汉装神弄鬼跳舞驱邪治病，常讽刺迷信。

examples.zh: 村里有人生病不看医生，请人来跳大神。
examples.en: In the village, some skip the doctor and hire someone to do a shaman dance.

examples.zh: 别信那些跳大神的把戏。
examples.en: Don't believe those shaman tricks.

usage.en: Strong northern (Dongbei) flavour; used literally or as mockery of nonsense.
usage.zh: 东北色彩浓，可指实际仪式，也可讽刺胡闹。

natural: keep going until you hit a wall

meaning.en: To persist stubbornly until failure forces you to stop.
meaning.zh: 固执地坚持，直到碰壁才罢休。

examples.zh: 不撞南墙不回头，他就是这个脾气。
examples.en: He won't turn back until he hits the wall; that's his temper.

examples.zh: 劝他也没用，他非要撞撞南墙。
examples.en: Advice is useless; he insists on hitting the wall himself.

usage.en: Mostly in 不撞南墙不回头; the wall faces the traveller, so there is no way through.
usage.zh: 多见于“不撞南墙不回头”。

meaning.en: To live off others by eating and drinking at their expense.
meaning.zh: 靠白吃白喝别人的东西过活。

examples.zh: 他整天到朋友家蹭吃蹭喝。
examples.en: He spends all day at friends' homes freeloading.

examples.zh: 别总想着蹭吃蹭喝，自己也请一次客吧。
examples.en: Stop always scrounging; treat people yourself for once.

usage.en: Casual, mildly humorous. 蹭 = rub against, hence get something free by hanging around.
usage.zh: 口语，略带调侃。“蹭”指沾光。

pinyin: zhàn zhe máo kēng bù lā shǐ
natural: hold a post and do nothing

meaning.en: To hold a position without doing the job, blocking others who could.
meaning.zh: 占着位置却不干事，也不让别人干。

equivalents: sit on a post and do nothing

examples.zh: 他占着茅坑不拉屎，把职位占了三年。
examples.en: He's been occupying the post doing nothing for three years.

examples.zh: 有些人占着茅坑不拉屎，让年轻人没有机会。
examples.en: Some hold posts and do nothing, denying young people a chance.

usage.en: Blunt and crude; the full phrase is usual, 占着茅坑 alone is understood.
usage.zh: 直白粗俗，多说全句。
